t2.title: It important for children to learn to play a musical instrument
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is it important for children to learn to play a musical instrument?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Physical Books in a Digital World

With e-readers and audiobooks dominating the market, some predict the death of physical books. But are printed books really becoming obsolete? I don't think so.

Firstly, the tactile experience of holding a book is irreplaceable. The smell of pages, the weight in your hands, and the satisfaction of turning pages create a sensory experience that screens cannot replicate.

Moreover, physical books offer cognitive benefits. Studies suggest we retain information better when reading print. There's also no eye strain from blue light or digital distractions.

Additionally, books as objects have sentimental value. A well-loved book on a shelf tells a story beyond its contents.

However, digital formats have advantages – portability, accessibility, and convenience are undeniable.

Ultimately, it's not an either-or situation. Both formats can coexist, serving different needs. What matters is that people continue reading, regardless of format!

What's your preference?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi Book Club!

Books are good. I like books. Meeting is okay. I like stories. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hi Book Club,

I like the books, and I like the meetings. But sometimes the books are long. I want more easy books. And I want more funny books because funny books are good. The meeting time is okay, but maybe a little earlier? Because I am tired. Thank you!

Bye!
t2.sampleB1:
Dear Book Club Members,

I'm writing to share my thoughts about the book club. Overall, I've enjoyed the book selections so far. I especially liked the last mystery novel. However, I think the meeting times could be better. It's difficult for me to attend on Tuesdays because I have a class.

In my opinion, it would be interesting to read more historical fiction books. Also, maybe we could have a movie night where we watch a film based on one of the books we've read. That would be fun!

Thank you for considering my suggestions.

Sincerely,
Kamola Qodirova
t2.sampleB2:
More Than Just Music

Ask any parent whether their child should learn an instrument, and you'll get a dozen different answers. In my opinion, though, picking up an instrument is one of the best things a child can do.

First and foremost, learning to play teaches discipline. Mastering the piano or the guitar doesn't happen overnight; it takes hours of patient practice, and children gradually learn that hard work pays off. This is a lesson that will serve them well far beyond the world of music.

What's more, music is a fantastic outlet for emotions. A child who has had a rough day can sit down at the keyboard and let off steam in a healthy, creative way.

On top of that, playing in a band or orchestra builds teamwork and confidence. Standing up in front of an audience is nerve-racking at first, but it soon boosts a child's self-esteem.

Of course, not every child will fall in love with music, and that's perfectly fine. Still, giving them the chance to try is well worth it. After all, the skills they pick up along the way last a lifetime.
t2.uzSample:
Raqamli Dunyoda Jismoniy Kitoblar

Elektron o‘quvchilar va audio kitoblar bozorda ustunlik qilayotgan bir paytda, ba’zilar jismoniy kitoblarning o‘limini bashorat qilmoqda. Ammo bosma kitoblar haqiqatan ham eskirib bormoqdami? Menimcha, yo‘q.

Birinchidan, kitobni ushlashning taktil tajribasi o‘rnini bosib bo‘lmaydi. Sahifalarning hidi, qo‘lingizdagi og‘irligi va sahifalarni varaqlashdan qoniqish ekranlar takrorlay olmaydigan hissiy tajribani yaratadi.

Bundan tashqari, jismoniy kitoblar kognitiv foyda keltiradi. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko‘rsatadiki, biz bosma nashrlarni o‘qiyotganda ma’lumotni yaxshiroq eslab qolamiz. Bundan tashqari, ko‘k yorug‘likdan ko‘zning zo‘riqishi yoki raqamli chalg‘ituvchi omillar ham yo‘q.

Qo‘shimcha ravishda, kitoblar ob’ekt sifatida sentimental qiymatga ega. Javondagi sevimli kitob o‘z mazmunidan tashqari hikoyani aytib beradi.

Biroq, raqamli formatlarning afzalliklari bor – ko‘chma, qulaylik va foydalanish imkoniyati inkor etib bo‘lmaydi.

Oxir oqibat, bu yoki u vaziyat emas. Ikkala format ham birga yashashi va turli ehtiyojlarga xizmat qilishi mumkin. Muhimi, odamlar formatidan qat’i nazar, o‘qishni davom ettirishidir!

Sizning afzalligingiz qanday?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom, Kitobxonlar Klubi!

Kitoblar yaxshi. Men kitoblarni yaxshi ko'raman. Uchrashuv yaxshi. Men hikoyalarni yaxshi ko'raman. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom, Kitobxonlar klubi,

Menga kitoblar yoqadi, va uchrashuvlar ham yoqadi. Lekin ba'zida kitoblar uzun bo'ladi. Men ko'proq oson kitoblar xohlayman. Va men ko'proq kulgili kitoblar xohlayman, chunki kulgili kitoblar yaxshi. Uchrashuv vaqti yaxshi, lekin balki biroz erta bo'lsa-chi? Chunki men charchaganman. Rahmat!

Xayr!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Kitobxonlar Klubi A'zolari,

Men kitobxonlar klubi haqidagi fikrlarimni baham ko'rish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, men shu paytgacha kitob tanlashlaridan zavqlandim. Menga ayniqsa oxirgi detektiv roman yoqdi. Biroq, menimcha, uchrashuv vaqtlari yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin. Seshanba kunlari darsim borligi sababli, qatnashish men uchun qiyin.

Mening fikrimcha, ko'proq tarixiy fantastika kitoblarini o'qish qiziqarli bo'lardi. Shuningdek, ehtimol biz kitoblardan biriga asoslangan filmni tomosha qiladigan kino kechasi o'tkazishimiz mumkin. Bu juda qiziqarli bo'lardi!

Takliflarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur.

Hurmat bilan,
Kamola Qodirova
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Kitobxonlar Klubi Tashkilotchilari,

Men kitobxonlar klubiga minnatdorchiligimni bildirish va kelajakdagi tadbirlar uchun ba'zi takliflar berish maqsadida yozyapman. Umuman olganda, kitob tanlovlari qiziqarli va fikrlashga undovchi ekanligini aniqladim, garchi oxirgi roman yaxshi yozilgan bo'lsa-da, ehtimol, oddiy o'qish uchun biroz murakkabroq edi. Uchrashuv vaqtlari asosan qulay, garchi ba'zida ish majburiyatlarim tufayli qatnashishga qiynalaman.

Kelajakdagi tanlovlarga kelsak, men ko'proq zamonaviy adabiyotni, ayniqsa, hozirgi ijtimoiy masalalarni yorituvchi kitoblarni o'rganishga qiziqardim. Bundan tashqari, bizning uchrashuvlarimizga kitoblarda taqdim etilgan mavzular atrofida guruh muhokamalari yoki bahslar kabi ko'proq interaktiv elementlarni kiritish foydali bo'ladi deb hisoblayman. Ehtimol, biz mahalliy mualliflarni ham uchrashuvlarimizda nutq so'zlashga taklif qilishimiz mumkin.

Faol o'qish jamiyatini rivojlantirishga qo'shgan hissangiz uchun tashakkur. Kelajakdagi kitobxonlar klubi tadbirlarida ishtirok etishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Kamola Qodirova

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is thinking about joining a book club. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! You should totally join a book club! I've been going to mine for a month and it's really fun! The discussions make me see books differently. Want me to ask if you can come along?
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Charos,
Book club is good. I like books. Come?
Bye.
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Charos,
I go to book club. It is fun. We read books and talk about them. I like the books, but the meeting is late. You should come because it is good. What do you think?
Bye!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Charos,
I wanted to tell you about the book club. I joined recently, and I'm enjoying it. It's nice to talk about books with other people. Sometimes the books are a bit boring, but overall, it's a good experience. The meetings are on Tuesdays, which is okay for me. I think you should join! It would be fun to go together. Let me know what you think.
Best,
Kamola Qodirova
t11.sampleB2:
Hey Charos,

So you're thinking about joining a book club? Honestly, go for it! I signed up last month and I'm completely hooked. It's such a laid-back way to unwind after work, and chatting about the plot really brings the stories to life. Want me to tag along with you? Let me know!

Kamola Karimova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the book club organizers. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear Book Club Organizers,

Thank you for inviting feedback. I have thoroughly enjoyed my time as a member.

Firstly, the book selections have been excellent. The variety of genres keeps discussions engaging and introduces members to new authors.

However, I would like to suggest some improvements. The Wednesday evening meetings are difficult for those with work commitments. Perhaps alternating between weekday and weekend sessions would accommodate more members.

Additionally, inviting local authors for occasional talks would be incredibly enriching.

Furthermore, creating an online discussion forum would allow members to continue conversations between meetings.

Thank you for fostering such a welcoming community.

Best regards,
An Enthusiastic Reader
t12.sampleA1:
Hi!


Book good. I like book. Meeting okay. More books?


Bye!
t12.sampleA2:
Hello Book Club!


I like the books, and they are interesting. But the meeting time is not good for me because I work. Can we meet Saturday or Sunday? I want to read more stories about animals and maybe watch a movie about a book we read. Thank you!


From, Kamola Qodirova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Book Club Organizers,


Thank you for the email. I wanted to give you my feedback about the book club. I think the books we have read so far are quite good, and I have enjoyed discussing them with everyone.


However, I have a suggestion. The meeting time is difficult for me because I work late on Tuesdays. Maybe we could change it to another day? Also, I think it would be interesting to read some books about history. I also think maybe we could have a party sometimes.


Thank you for listening to my ideas.


Sincerely,
Kamola Qodirova
t12.sampleB2:
Dear Book Club Organizers,

Thank you for reaching out and inviting our feedback. I am delighted to say that joining the club has been one of the highlights of my month.

On the whole, the book selections have been varied and thought-provoking, and I have enjoyed discovering authors I would never have picked up on my own. That said, I do have a couple of suggestions. The current meeting times clash with my work commitments, so alternating between weekday and weekend sessions would allow more of us to take part.

I would also love to see the occasional guest talk from a local author, as well as a group chat where we could carry on our discussions between meetings.

Thank you for building such a warm and welcoming community.

Yours sincerely,
Bekzod Aliyev
